title: 哈姆雷特 5-2 最終決鬥
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, cold gothic atmosphere
characters: Hamlet, a lean young prince dressed head to toe in black, a short dark cloak, tousled dark hair, pale clean-shaven face with shadowed sleepless eyes

panels.prompt: {characters} recounting to Horatio, a sober young scholar in a plain dark scholar's gown with a high collar, short neatly combed brown hair, a small leather book at his belt, by a narrow window, a flashback vignette behind them: a hooded figure by lantern light opening a sealed packet in a ship's cabin

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 我在黑夜裡摸到他們的公文——國王的密令，要英格蘭砍了我的頭。我另外偽造了一封：處死送信的人。
dialogue.en: Groped I to find out them; had my desire... an exact command... my head should be struck off. / I sat me down, devised a new commission... that... he should the bearers put to sudden death.

panels.prompt: close two-shot at the window, grey sea light, the prince strangely calm, the scholar troubled

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 無論我們怎樣辛苦圖謀，我們的結局，早已有一種冥冥中的力量把它布置好了。
dialogue.en: There's a divinity that shapes our ends, rough-hew them how we will.

quote.text: 冥冥中的力量布置好了我們的結局
quote.en: There's a divinity that shapes our ends.

panels.prompt: a foppish young courtier in an enormous plumed hat bowing so low his hat sweeps the floor before the unimpressed black-clad prince

dialogue.speaker: 奧斯里克
dialogue.text: 殿下——王上以六匹巴巴利駿馬為賭注，請您和雷歐提斯先生比劍，十二個回合。
dialogue.en: The king, sir, hath wagered with him six Barbary horses... The king, sir, hath laid, that in a dozen passes between yourself and him, he shall not exceed you three hits.

panels.prompt: {characters} and Horatio, a sober young scholar in a plain dark scholar's gown with a high collar, short neatly combed brown hair, a small leather book at his belt, alone in the anteroom before tall doors, the scholar gripping the prince's arm in warning, the prince gently shaking his head

dialogue.speaker: 霍拉旭
dialogue.text: 您一定會輸的，殿下。要是您心裡不願意，我去替您推辭。
dialogue.en: You will lose this wager, my lord... If your mind dislike any thing, obey it: I will forestall their repair hither.

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 不。一隻雀子的死生，都有命運預先注定。隨時準備著就是了。
dialogue.en: Not a whit, we defy augury: there's a special providence in the fall of a sparrow... The readiness is all.

panels.prompt: the great hall set for the duel: a long table with wine cups, King Claudius, a broad heavyset king with a neatly trimmed dark pointed beard, a wide gold crown, fur-trimmed brocade robes, a jeweled goblet in hand, and Queen Gertrude, a stately middle-aged queen with coiled auburn braids under a golden circlet, in a layered brocade gown, enthroned, courtiers ringing a cleared floor, {characters} offering his open hand to Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 原諒我，雷歐提斯——我得罪了你。得罪你的不是哈姆雷特，是他的瘋狂。
dialogue.en: Give me your pardon, sir: I've done you wrong... Was't Hamlet wrong'd Laertes? Never Hamlet... His madness is poor Hamlet's enemy.

panels.prompt: close-up of a rack of rapiers, the young nobleman's hand deliberately drawing out one blade whose tip has no safety button, a bead of dark oil glistening along its edge

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 在感情上，我已經滿足了。……來，給我一柄。這一柄正合手。
dialogue.en: I am satisfied in nature... I do receive your offer'd love like love... Come, one for me... This is too heavy, let me see another.

panels.prompt: dynamic fencing panel, the two duellists mid-exchange across the cleared floor, blades crossed high, courtiers a blur of watching faces, the black-clad prince pressing forward

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 中了！
dialogue.en: One.

dialogue.speaker: 奧斯里克
dialogue.text: 中了，明明白白地中了。
dialogue.en: A hit, a very palpable hit.

quote.en: A hit, a very palpable hit.

panels.prompt: macro shot of a heavy ringed hand releasing a great pearl above a brimming wine cup, the pearl caught mid-fall a finger's width from the dark wine, blurred candles and the watching hall beyond the rim

dialogue.speaker: 克勞地
dialogue.text: 哈姆雷特，這一顆珍珠是你的！為你的健康——乾杯。把這杯酒給他。
dialogue.en: Stay; give me drink. Hamlet, this pearl is thine; here's to thy health... Give him the cup.

panels.prompt: Queen Gertrude, a stately middle-aged queen with coiled auburn braids under a golden circlet, in a layered brocade gown, lifting the pearl cup toward her son with a proud smile, the king half-risen from his throne with an outstretched arrested hand

dialogue.speaker: 葛簇特
dialogue.text: 王后為你的勝利乾杯，哈姆雷特。
dialogue.en: The queen carouses to thy fortune, Hamlet.

dialogue.speaker: 克勞地
dialogue.text: 葛簇特，不要喝！
dialogue.en: Gertrude, do not drink.

dialogue.speaker: 葛簇特
dialogue.text: 我要喝的，陛下——請您原諒我。
dialogue.en: I will, my lord; I pray you, pardon me.

panels.prompt: close shot of a ringed hand strangling the carved armrest of the throne, knuckles white, beside it a wine cup in which the dark surface trembles, the duel a blur of motion in the deep background

dialogue.speaker: 克勞地
dialogue.text: （內心）那一杯就是毒酒——太遲了。
dialogue.en: (aside) It is the poison'd cup: it is too late.

panels.prompt: chaotic scuffle panel: the young nobleman lunging a treacherous thrust that scores the prince's arm outside the bout, then both grappling close, rapiers wrenched from hand to hand in the confusion

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 雷歐提斯偷襲得手。混戰之中——兩人的劍，換了手。
dialogue.en: Laertes wounds Hamlet; then, in scuffling, they change rapiers.

panels.prompt: the prince's counter-thrust catching the young nobleman, while behind them Queen Gertrude, a stately middle-aged queen with coiled auburn braids under a golden circlet, in a layered brocade gown, sways and crashes against the long table, cups scattering

dialogue.speaker: 葛簇特
dialogue.text: 那杯酒，那杯酒——我中毒了。
dialogue.en: The drink, the drink! I am poison'd.

quote.en: The drink, the drink! I am poison'd.

panels.prompt: Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, fallen against an overturned bench, pressing his wound, confessing with the last of his strength, pointing across the hall

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 奸計反害了我自己……劍上有毒，你也活不過半小時了。罪魁是國王——是國王！
dialogue.en: The foul practise hath turn'd itself on me... In thee there is not half an hour of life; the treacherous instrument is in thy hand, unbated and envenom'd... the king, the king's to blame.

panels.prompt: {characters} driving the envenomed rapier into King Claudius, a broad heavyset king with a neatly trimmed dark pointed beard, a wide gold crown, fur-trimmed brocade robes, a jeweled goblet in hand, against his toppling throne, forcing the pearl cup toward the king's mouth with the other hand, courtiers shrinking back in a ring of horror

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 好，毒藥，發揮你的力量吧！——喝乾這杯酒，跟我的母親一起去吧！
dialogue.en: The point envenom'd too! Then, venom, to thy work!... Drink off this potion... Follow my mother.

panels.prompt: the two young men reaching toward each other across the wrecked floor, the dying nobleman's hand clasped in the prince's

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 高貴的哈姆雷特，讓我們互相寬恕——我的死和我父親的死，都不算在你頭上；你的死，也不算在我頭上。
dialogue.en: Exchange forgiveness with me, noble Hamlet: mine and my father's death come not upon thee, nor thine on me.

panels.prompt: {characters} sinking into the arms of Horatio, a sober young scholar in a plain dark scholar's gown with a high collar, short neatly combed brown hair, a small leather book at his belt, who has snatched the poisoned cup away from his own lips, wine spilling across the flagstones

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 霍拉旭，我死了，你還活著。請你暫時犧牲天堂的幸福，留在這個冷酷的人間，替我把故事告訴世人。
dialogue.en: Horatio, I am dead; thou livest; report me and my cause aright to the unsatisfied... Absent thee from felicity awhile, and in this harsh world draw thy breath in pain, to tell my story.

panels.prompt: close-up of the prince's face at rest in the scholar's arms, the shadowed sleepless eyes finally closed, one hand open and empty on the stone floor

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 餘下的——只有沉默。
dialogue.en: The rest is silence.

panels.prompt: wide final shot of the great hall from above: four royal bodies among overturned benches, the scholar kneeling at the centre, distant doors opening to soldiers with banners silhouetted against dawn light

dialogue.speaker: 霍拉旭
dialogue.text: 一顆高貴的心，碎了。晚安，親愛的王子——願成群的天使，歌唱著送你安息。
dialogue.en: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince: and flights of angels sing thee to thy rest!

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 挪威的軍號聲由遠而近。四具王族的屍體——和一個終於可以被完整說出的故事。全劇終。
dialogue.en: Fortinbras' drums draw near. Four royal bodies — and a story that can at last be told whole. The end.
